description:
Celebrate National Parks Week with National Geographic in this America's National Parks MEGA Episode! Witness the natural wonder of the scenic Grand Canyon, Saguaro National Park, Zion National Park, Yellowstone, and Yosemite. Learn about the animals that call these places home, including bears, wolves, and more, and the unique features of each of these special parks. Featuring three, full episodes: 

America's National Parks Compilation S2: Grand Canyon & Saguaro - 00:00 
Grand Canyon National Park is home to what may be the most famous natural wonder, and Saguaro National Park is home to more species than any other desert in North America.

National Parks: USA: Zion - 44:02 
In Zion National Park, sandstone cliffs, slot canyons and the Virgin River converge, sculpting a vibrant landscape and refuge for wildlife to thrive.
